name: t2d_mouse_msigdb
description: T2D seed-replication sweep. Bundled T2D GWAS fixture (P < 1e-6 subset of the portal T2D sumstats) against the full mouse_2024 + msigdb_nohp libraries from bundles/model_large-2026.02.22 -- the same two libraries as the portal 'mouse_msigdb' model. PIGEAN gibbs defaults everywhere else, so the sweep measures the shipped behaviour rather than a tuned variant.
